name: Gästehaus Berghof
beschreibung:
Peacefully perched on an elevated site in Berwang, Gaestehaus Berghof boasts unobstructed views of the surrounding peaks. Comfortably furnished rooms and apartments provide a restful retreat.

Hiking paths, mountain bike trails, and the Berwang ski area are readily accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Berghof in Berwang features cosy accommodation with panoramic vistas in the Zugspitz Arena.
